pull_request.title: Tracker: compare strixel lengths, reconstruction and service tradeoffs
pull_request.head: codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study
pull_request.body:
## Findings

Compare 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2 mm strixel local-v lengths at fixed 75 µm fine pitch on the maintained tracker. This DES-042 prototype reports tracking and conditional service tradeoffs without changing the detector baseline.

- Strixel channel counts fall by **50%, 66.7% and 75%** at 1, 1.5 and 2 mm. Cable/power estimates are conditional accounting scenarios; no physical service redesign or material reduction is simulated.
- The single-particle GBTS cross-check covers **80 × 1,000 native case-events**, five particle/transport populations and four pT values. At 2 mm, the central 100 GeV muon z0 core is **10.6% wider in Fatras and 15.1% wider in Geant4** than at 0.5 mm on the same common matched events.
- Fatras ttbar + exactly 200 pileup interactions uses **100 shared physical events reconstructed at each length**. After ambiguity resolution and guide-like analysis cuts:

| Strixel length | Hard-scatter efficiency [%] | Pileup efficiency [%] | Fake fraction [%] | Fake fraction, frozen quality only [%] |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.5 mm | 80.36 | 75.81 | 0.195 | 3.46 |
| 1 mm | 80.40 | 75.86 | 0.181 | 3.65 |
| 1.5 mm | 80.40 | 75.90 | 0.204 | 3.94 |
| 2 mm | 80.36 | 75.91 | 0.230 | 4.24 |

For 2 mm minus 0.5 mm, the guide-selected hard-scatter efficiency change is **0.000 percentage points [−0.211, +0.202]**, and the fake-fraction change is **+0.034 [+0.005, +0.064] percentage points**, with paired pointwise 95% event-bootstrap intervals. Equal aggregate efficiency does not establish equivalence.

![ttbar efficiency and candidate composition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/ttbar-pu200/figures/guide-overview.png)

Reports: [truth tracking and service estimates](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/results.md), [single-particle GBTS](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/gbts/summary.md), [ttbar + pileup](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/docs/validation/DES-042/ttbar-pu200/README.md). Reports link the complete figure sets, definitions, uncertainty intervals and independent assessments.

## Included artifacts and reproduction

Includes **78 PNG/PDF exports**, concise reports/provenance, and the generation, reconstruction, audit, statistics and plotting scripts with tests. The recipes document environments, source/configuration/input hashes, seeds and exact commands:

- [Truth-associated pitch/service workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_pitch_study/README.md)
- [Single-particle GBTS workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_reconstruction/README.md)
- [Fatras ttbar + pileup workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/strixel-pitch-truth-study/software/analysis/strixel_ttbar/README.md)

**No event-level run files, ROOT outputs, NPZ arrays, compressed case datasets or caches are added to the PR.** All 674 excluded study files remain local and ignored, with hashes in the compact artifact inventory. Large unpublished payload commits were removed from the history to be pushed; original local snapshots remain archived for provenance. The published tree retains the pinned native-validator history. Plots and scientific source contents are unchanged by that cleanup.

Task-owned Pythia/Fatras/GBTS components provide the missing runtime binding and numerically safe evaluation needed for the repeatable chain. Numerical corrections preserve selected observables/random draws and are backed by native controls and byte-identical particle/hit/reconstruction replay; they remain isolated from shared dependencies and production geometry.

## Validation and interpretation

- **144 Python tests** and all **78 figure hashes/source bindings** pass. A separate clean checkout containing no DES-042 datasets passes the same tests and project/session/usage/workflow checks.
- All 400 ttbar reconstruction payloads and all 100 Fatras sample payloads match the preserved originals byte-for-byte. Full portable replay and 2,000 paired event-bootstrap calculations pass locally. Independent PhysVal assessment reproduced all 1,864 metrics/intervals and 10,920 representative count checks with no unresolved blocker.
- CI checks synthetic analysis tests and published figure integrity. Full native/event/statistical replay explicitly requires the local retained data or a regenerated campaign; it is not claimed as a data-free CI check.

Qualifications: constant 3 T and fixed geometry/material; the GBTS/ttbar scans use uncalibrated Gaussian local-v response without cluster merging. Boundary retries also change non-target smearing. The unchanged 2,000,000-edge GBTS cap is reached in **99/100 ttbar events**. The ttbar hard process follows the guide's **qqbar-only** setup. Six low-momentum Fatras step-limit losses remain documented; none is headline-eligible. These are qualified prototype results, without physical coarse-cell occupancy calibration, hardware-service qualification or design acceptance.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated project tracking with the DES-042 study and linked reports; no baseline geometry/material change, so no layout regeneration is needed.
- [x] Local tests and project/session/usage/workflow checks pass; unavailable exact client token counters remain explicitly missing.
- [x] Plots and reproduction recipes retained; large reference-run payloads excluded from the PR tree and newly pushed data-bearing history.
- [x] Human approval boundaries retained; DES-042 and ADR-003 remain DRAFT/PROTOTYPE.
- [x] Added the individual `interactions/pr-0109.json` record with six canonical session links, captured public metadata/discussion, known agent roles and tool provenance; exact unavailable token usage remains missing.

The governing DES-042 amendment was saved before implementation. It declares a
PROTOTYPE, complete 80-case matrix, 1,000 generated events/case, frozen Gaussian
response with only strixel local-v sigma scaled, existing pixel-only GBTS,
all-system CKF, fixed geometry/material/3T and hypotheses/cuts. No retuning.
Statistical uncertainty and response-model limitations are required outputs.

Explicit role fallback through repository workflow; native profile loading is
not claimed. Assignments use the full initial revision and pinned Git inputs:

- `STRIXEL-GBTS-SoftEng-01`, child `/root/strixel_gbts_softeng`: runtime/campaign,
  four new owned files, native smoke; [assignment](SESSION-2026-10-31-strixel-gbts-crosscheck/softeng-01-assignment.json).
- `STRIXEL-GBTS-PhysVal-01`, child `/root/strixel_gbts_physval`: separate read-only
  protocol assessment; [assignment](SESSION-2026-10-31-strixel-gbts-crosscheck/physval-01-assignment.json).
- `STRIXEL-GBTS-SoftEng-02`, child `/root/strixel_gbts_analysis`: analysis,
  retention and plots, three disjoint owned files;
  [assignment](SESSION-2026-10-31-strixel-gbts-crosscheck/analysis-01-assignment.json).

Children may not delegate, publish, modify shared dependencies or frozen helpers.
Coordinator owns scientific integration, project tracking and final evidence.

events.text:
Native scan:12×20000processed case-events, pT1/10/100GeV, constant3T, one origin
muon/event, random charge, uniformeta[-4,4], fullphi. Three concurrent one-thread
processes. All pitches share exact generated/all-hit/primary-hit payloads at each
momentum; native geometry/material/selection stay invariant. Only12384strixel-v
grids differ; all seven sensitive-system counts match the balanced tracker.
Every1GeVcase has19995finite/native-matched fits and the same5selection losses;
every10/100GeVcase has20000. No post-selection fit failure/native invalidcovariance.
Total239980finite/native-matched fits from240000case-events; pitches are paired,
not independent physics samples. Full55file/output hashes and actual per-sensor
configuration comparisons pass.

At100GeV, |eta|<1, the native geometric z0core ratio at2mm is0.769±0.014,
while its uncut SD ratio is~0.939 and pull SD falls0.543→0.458. All5036events
fit at everypitch, so this is not survivor bias. Source/pilot inspection shows
native merged-cell path weights couple both coordinate covariances: fine-u
positions stay bitwise identical but mean fine-u variance changes~12.8% asv
coarsens. Digital flags do not establish an independent binary response after
merging. Coupling is demonstrated; its complete causal contribution is not.
These results do not show improved physical sensor performance.

Separate, prospectively frozen Gaussian diagnostic:4×5000cases at100GeV,
all measured-coordinate widths=pitch/sqrt(12), no merging, 1D long strips.
Native source58f49b9 captured by all4launches before parent advancedHEAD.
Everycase has5000finite/native-matched fits,73907simhits/measurements,0lost,
0nativeinvalidcovariance. All517888stored marginal variance checks pass.
Exact truth/simhits match acrosscontrols and original geometric first5000events;
original twelve-case outputs/fingerprints remain unchanged. Native edge draws
have at most11attempts; actual retry counts unavailable, so0lost is not0retries.
All-axis response replacement tests model dependence, not a single causal term.

Gaussian central100GeV width ratios (paired400-draw SE):z0=1.106±0.019,
1.117±0.022,1.132±0.024 for1/1.5/2mm;theta=1.159±0.023,1.216±0.028,
1.229±0.031. Central longitudinal pull widths are near1; momentum pulls retain
substantial nonclosure. Native geometric1/10GeVlongitudinal changes are small;
momentum-width summary changes stay percent-scale. No physical calibration,
occupancy/pattern-recognition claim, or smaller-service-material benefit enters
the fixed-material study. No preferred baseline is selected.

Service scan:channel reduction50/66.7/75%. Existing unqualified electronics
comparators7.8W and31.7288W/module, channel-dependent fractionf=0/0.5/1,
fixed2W/moduleHVleakage and5W/network boards, recomputed local12Vrail loss.
Forf=1 modeled heat savings49–201/65–268/73–301kW; these spans compare proxy
normalizations, not physical bounds. Longer-cell capacitance/ASIC power unknown.
Withf=0.5 heat savings24–101/32–135/36–151kW; withf=0 zero.

Unchanged hardware saveszero installed cable/cooling/tray/electronics space.
Conditional redesigned power harnesses remove gross242.734/273.421/273.421L
for1/1.5/2mm atf=1, keeping fibres/pipes/trays fixed. Envelope includes internal
void; Cu/PI/void reported separately. Requires new conductors/fanouts/connectors/
LV-HV-control topology and engineering. Area-equivalent worst-sector demand
75.590mm baseline already exceeds actual73mm allocation; conditional demands
46.717/41.000mm leave26.3/32.0mm area-only headroom before installation reserves.
No qualified current capacity, narrower corridor or reduced pipe diameter follows.
